Auf große Marken sowie Umweltorganisationen geschaltete Anzeigen liefen unfreiwillig vor solchen Inhalten. Bei der Suche 'global warming' enthielten 16 % der Top-100-Empfehlungen Falschinformationen.
description_en: A January 2020 report by NGO Avaaz showed YouTube's recommendation algorithm surfacing climate-misinformation videos to millions of users and letting their creators earn money through the ad programme. Ads from major brands and even environmental groups ran against this content without their intent. For the query 'global warming', 16% of the top 100 recommended videos contained misinformation.
